A gas is in a sealed container with a fixed volume.
Which statements describe what happens to the molecules in the gas when the temperature is
increased?
1
They move more slowly.
2
They collide with the walls of the container more frequently.
3
They collide with the walls of the container with less force.
4
They have greater kinetic energy.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
